text: Additional exact failure matrix: PosAcceptService.applyEvent catches AppError after rolling back the per-document central transaction. Only BIN_LOCKED_FOR_COUNT/STOCK_INSUFFICIENT are declared retryable; other AppErrors (including early missing markdown/item and replay/bounds failures) become pos_sync_rejections and edge REJECTED, requiring explicit admin replay. Non-AppError programming/DB errors propagate HTTP failure: edge SyncRunner catches, Outbox.failed leaves PENDING with attempt/error and exponential retry. Thus current code does NOT promise automatic retry for every expiry failure, though cashier edge checkout is already committed. This is a real limit to review, not hidden by the port refactor. Existing staleapproval/budget paths accept centrally as unallocated; missing-source AppErrors can park a completedsale. We will document this and add fault-injection tests before expiry transaction push; if the owner requires ALL secondary-module failures to allow immediate central posting as well, that is a different transaction/queue design and must be agreed explicitly, not silently implemented. Please confirm the required boundary after this distinction.
